name: Zest v1

priceBasis.protocol: stx-btc-oracle-v1-7: Pyth Lazer feeds 1 (BTC) / 45 (STX) opened per tx, max age 360 s; stSTX = STX x data-stx-v2 ratio; stSTXbtc = STX; aeUSDC/USDH/sUSDT and legacy assets use fixed-price oracle contracts
priceBasis.monitor: 7-venue CEX median for BTC/STX; the stSTX ratio and every fixed-price oracle read on-chain at the block (the protocol's own value, even where it differs from market)

bandSource: Max Lazer-vs-reference deviation at block time in successful priced txs (measured from 1,583 decoded Lazer-carrying txs, 2026-08-13..09-22).

pointers.label: Entry point approved on the lending pool

candidates.meaning: pre-approved v1->v2 migration contract (zip-054). Already true in pool-borrow-v2-4.approved-contracts, so its deploy IS its activation: it can move v1 positions without going through borrow-helper
next entry point; needs a zip to approve it (>= 144 burn blocks)

prices.method: median of last traded 1m candle close (<=300 s old) before block time; USDT quotes x median USDT/USD (kraken, coinbase)

discovery.method: union of users-id over every pool-borrow version, plus current holders of every zToken (candidates only), then get-user-assets per principal at the block
